aspect: Requirements that are discovered rather than published
description: Notarisation age, translator accreditation, seal type, whether a digital transcript counts. These are rarely stated in advance and are applied as though they were obvious.
energy_note: A rule you were required to know and nobody published.

aspect: Each cure has a fee and a wait
description: Reissuing, retranslating, re-notarising. The cost lands entirely on the applicant, and the institution that failed to state the requirement bears none of it.
energy_note: Paying to satisfy a rule you were told about afterwards.

aspect: It is worse where the issuing institution is damaged
description: Where a university, registry or ministry cannot answer a verification request, the absence is attributed to the applicant as suspected fraud rather than to the institution as a records problem.
energy_note: An archive failure, read as a lie about yourself.
notes: Connects to DOC and EDU categories in assets/text/{nigeria,palestine,iran}.

description: Her degree is genuine. The evaluator needs an apostille. Her country is not party to the convention. The evaluator's form has no box for that, so the file is marked incomplete, and there is nobody whose job it is to resolve a category error.
energy_note: Incomplete, permanently, because of a treaty she is not party to.
